title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Performance Evaluation of Public Officials)
(1) Performance evaluations of public officials of Grade VI or lower assigned to a branch office under Article 6 (2) shall be conducted by the head of the General Affairs Division of the relevant High Court after hearing the opinion of a senior official of Grade V or higher in the branch office. <Amended on May 20, 1995>
(2) Evaluations of District Court officials concurrently serving in a branch office under Article 6 (3) shall be conducted by the District Court. <Amended on May 20, 1995>
